description: Candidate company pairs labelled for capability COMPLEMENTARITY (0 = not complementary, 1 = plausible, 2 = strong).
labelled_by: NEXUS development team (AI-assisted), from the public member-directory descriptions. NOT labelled by Blue Science Park staff or independent domain experts.
caveat: The labeller also wrote the capability relation table, so this set is biased in favour of NEXUS. It is a sanity check, not a validation. 36 pairs are too few for statistically meaningful conclusions.
